title: General
text: The network configures the L2 U2N Relay UE with relay operation related configurations.
For each connected L2 U2N Remote UE indicated in sl-L2Identity-Remote,   the network provides the configuration parameters used for data
The UE performs the following actions based on a received sl-L2RelayUEConfig:
1 >  if the sl-L2RelayUEConfig contains the sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList:
2 >  perform the L2 U2N Remote UE release as specified in 5.3.5.15.2;
1 >  if the sl-L2RelayUEConfig contains the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList:
2 >  perform the L2 U2N Remote UE addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.15.3;
